page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a distinct performance profile. Single-core performance is relatively weak, scoring in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, with single-threaded gzip compression falling into the bottom 10%. However, the instance leverages its 32 dedicated cores to deliver average multi-core performance, as evidenced by middle-tier results in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth also performs in the average range, reaching 99.19 GB/sec for large-block read operations.

Given its high memory capacity and average multi-core capabilities, the ecs.se1ne.8xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand high single-thread CPU speeds. It is appropriate for database operations, caching layers such as Redis, and memory-bound data processing. It is less suitable for single-threaded applications or workloads requiring high-speed local storage.
